component.description: The answer component handles user input for various types of responses including audio recordings in the content editor. This component manages the recording functionality and displays appropriate feedback when recording operations succeed or fail.

_meta.context: This error message appears when a recording operation fails within the answer component of the content editor. Users see this message when attempting to record audio or video content for their assignments or learning materials and the recording process encounters a technical failure.
_meta.impact: High - Recording failures prevent users from completing multimedia assignments and can cause frustration if not clearly communicated.
_meta.usage: Error message displayed when audio or video recording fails during content creation or assignment submission.

component.description: The AnswerComponent handles the display and validation of student answers in interactive learning exercises. It provides immediate feedback to students based on their responses, showing success or error messages to guide their learning progress.

_meta.context: This feedback text appears in the AnswerComponent when a student submits a correct answer to a quiz question or interactive exercise. The message is displayed immediately after the student selects or submits their answer, providing positive reinforcement for their successful response.
_meta.impact: High - This positive feedback is crucial for student motivation and learning reinforcement in the Japanese language learning platform
_meta.usage: Success feedback message displayed when students answer quiz questions correctly

component.description: The AnswerComponent handles interactive quiz elements and answer validation within learning units. It displays feedback to students based on their submitted answers and manages the retry flow for incorrect responses.

_meta.usage: Feedback message that appears after incorrect answer submission, typically displayed as text or within a button to prompt retry action.
